description: A hospital operations administrator must finalize the Friday contingency plan for the hospital dialysis unit during a scheduled closure, choosing one partner dialysis site and arranging the start time, transport, and patient support with input from nephrology, facilities, patient transport, and social work.

shared_context.S1: The hospital's dialysis unit will be closed all day Friday for a planned water-system inspection.
shared_context.S2: Friday's dialysis patients must be scheduled at one of two partner sites: Riverside Dialysis Center or Lakeside Dialysis Center.
shared_context.S3: The Friday patients are already scheduled for treatment and need a coordinated contingency plan before Thursday afternoon.
shared_context.S4: Marisol has authority to approve the partner site and the operational plan.
shared_context.S5: As part of the hospital's routine contingency-planning process, Marisol checks in with nephrology, facilities, patient transport, and social work before approving the plan.

PF1.text: One patient in Friday's cohort requires an isolation-capable dialysis station, and Riverside has one available isolation station while Lakeside does not. Dr. Chen confirmed this requirement during today's clinical review.

PF2.text: Riverside's Friday water-quality clearance will be complete at 06:30, so its first usable dialysis session can begin at exactly 07:00; Lakeside can begin at 06:00. Liam received the clearance schedule from Riverside's facilities lead.

PF3.text: An accessible hospital van is reserved for the Friday cohort with pickup at exactly 06:15 and direct transport to Riverside Dialysis Center. Nadia booked the van with the transport dispatch desk.

PF4.text: The caregiver accompanying one Friday patient is available only from 07:00 to 09:00 and requested a certified Spanish interpreter for the Riverside appointment. Ruth confirmed both details with the caregiver.

acceptance_conditions: The Friday cohort must be assigned to Riverside Dialysis Center.
The first usable dialysis session must begin at exactly 07:00.
An isolation-capable dialysis station must be reserved.
The accessible hospital van must be scheduled for pickup at exactly 06:15 with Riverside as the destination.
A caregiver-support commitment covering 07:00 to 09:00 must be recorded.
A certified Spanish interpreter must be committed for the appointment.
The isolation-station requirement must be explicitly cited as justification for the site choice.

content_checks.C4: decisions['transport_pickup_time'] == '06:15' and any(c['type'] == 'accessible_transport' and c['target'] == 'Riverside Dialysis Center' and c['detail'] == 'hospital van' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'caregiver_support' and c['target'] == 'Friday dialysis patient' and c['detail'] == 'caregiver present 07:00-09:00' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'interpreter' and c['target'] == 'Friday dialysis patient' and c['detail'] == 'certified Spanish interpreter' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The isolation requirement changes the site choice from either partner location to Riverside and changes the plan from no special station to reserving an isolation-capable station.
The 06:30 Riverside clearance changes the first session time from the earlier Lakeside-compatible 06:00 start to exactly 07:00.
The confirmed accessible van and its exact 06:15 pickup change the transport plan from unspecified transportation to a hospital van departing at 06:15 for Riverside.

The caregiver's exact 07:00-09:00 availability changes the plan to include that support window, while the language request changes interpreter support from unspecified to a certified Spanish interpreter.
